mechanism_narrative: Lower levels of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential construction starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic contraction that lowers corporate profit expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) increase borrowing costs and reduce corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High residential construction starts (HOUST) indicate strong housing market activity that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 600 thousand units, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining consumer spending (RSAFS < 340 billion) signals weakening retail demand that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 340000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal a dual shock of labor market deterioration and monetary tightening that severely dampens economic activity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when both UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS increases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 97.0) indicates manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during industrial slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 97.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
